brand_identity.positioning: Boutique Luxury Private Dental & Cosmetic Centre
brand_identity.target_audience: Discerning patients seeking premium cosmetic transformations & Invisalign aligners in Rochester and surrounding Kent area
brand_identity.tone_of_voice: Warm, reassuring, medically authoritative, transparent, non-pressured luxury

color_palette.rules: Use Gold (#D19A15) exclusively for high-value highlights, pricing badges, key CTAs, and subtle glowing accent borders. Use Dark Grey (#4C4C4C) for soft readable body text. Never use flat pure black backgrounds without gold/glass depth.

hierarchy.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-serif font-medium tracking-tight leading-[1.15]
hierarchy.h2_section: text-2xl sm:text-3xl lg:text-4xl font-serif font-semibold tracking-tight leading-snug
hierarchy.caption_eyebrow: text-xs uppercase tracking-[0.25em] font-sans font-bold text-[#D19A15]

layout_and_spacing.bento_grid_mode: Tetris Grid with Gold Micro-Borders (gap-6 lg:gap-8)
layout_and_spacing.sticky_nav: Fixed Header with Glassmorphism (backdrop-blur-xl bg-white/80 border-b border-[#D19A15]/15 z-50)
layout_and_spacing.sticky_mobile_bar: Fixed bottom bar on mobile (<768px) with 3 action buttons: Call Clinic, WhatsApp, Book Consultation (z-50)

motion_and_interactions.smooth_scroll: Lenis momentum scroll engine integrated at root layer
motion_and_interactions.hero_animation: Masked line-by-line staggered reveal on initial load using framer-motion
motion_and_interactions.section_reveals: Scroll-triggered opacity fade-in + 20px upward translation with viewport once: true
motion_and_interactions.micro_interactions: Hover elevation (-4px transform y), CTA subtle gold radial pulse glow, interactive before/after slider comparison tool
motion_and_interactions.marquee: Slow editorial text ribbon drifting horizontally with category tags and patient quotes using react-fast-marquee

key_components_breakdown.name: Navigation Header
key_components_breakdown.description: Sticky luxury nav bar with GM Dental logo mark, desktop links (Cosmetic, Invisalign, Pricing, Reviews, FAQ), click-to-call direct phone, and 'Book Free Assessment' Gold CTA button.

key_components_breakdown.name: Kinetic Hero Section
key_components_breakdown.description: Eyebrow 'COSMETIC DENTISTRY AT GM DENTAL ROCHESTER', Headline 'Your Dream Smile. A Plan Made for You.', supporting clinical copy, gold call-to-action buttons, and inline instant Lead Enquiry Form.

key_components_breakdown.description: High-converting form with Full Name, Mobile, Email, Preferred Treatment selector (Invisalign, Whitening, Bonding, Veneers, Smile Makeover), and Rochester location indicator. Submits via POST /api/enquiry with toast confirmation.

key_components_breakdown.description: Interactive showcase cards for key treatments: Teeth Whitening, Composite Bonding, Porcelain Veneers, Full Smile Makeovers with before/after preview triggers.

key_components_breakdown.name: Dedicated Invisalign Offer Section
key_components_breakdown.description: Eyebrow 'STRAIGHTEN YOUR SMILE', Heading 'Discover Invisalign at GM Dental Rochester'. 3 confirmed pricing cards: Express (£2,400), Lite (£3,000), Comprehensive (£3,990). Highlights free initial assessment, 3D smile simulation, and finance options from £50.40/month.

key_components_breakdown.name: Interactive Before & After Slider
key_components_breakdown.description: Draggable side-by-side smile comparison tool allowing prospective patients to slide between pre-treatment and post-treatment results.

key_components_breakdown.name: Patient Journey 5-Step Process
key_components_breakdown.description: Step 1: Free Consultation & 3D Scan -> Step 2: Digital Smile Design -> Step 3: Customized Treatment Plan -> Step 4: Comfortable Application -> Step 5: Lifetime Retention & Aftercare.

key_components_breakdown.name: Patient Video & Review Testimonials
key_components_breakdown.description: Video player modal cards featuring real patient stories (Elizabeth & Ella) alongside verified Google/Trustpilot star rating reviews.

key_components_breakdown.name: Clinic Trust & Facilities Gallery
key_components_breakdown.description: High-res photography showcase of GM Dental Rochester clinic interior, state-of-the-art iTero 3D scanner, comfortable treatment suites, and specialist team.

key_components_breakdown.name: Comprehensive FAQ Accordion
key_components_breakdown.description: 10 medically responsible, clear collapsible questions regarding Invisalign cost, treatment duration, pain level, finance options, and consultation procedure.

key_components_breakdown.name: Discreet Mobile Sticky Action Bar
key_components_breakdown.description: Bottom fixed navigation bar visible on mobile devices with quick tap options for Call, WhatsApp, and Book Form modal trigger.

key_components_breakdown.name: Footer
key_components_breakdown.description: Luxury dark section with clinic address (Rochester, Kent), opening hours, GDC regulation notes, contact phone/email, map link, and copyright.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly adhere to the brand palette: Gold (#D19A15) for CTAs, pricing badges & highlights; Dark Grey (#4C4C4C) for body text; White and warm subtle tones for container backgrounds.
Ensure every interactive element has explicit data-testid attributes formatted in kebab-case.
Do NOT use raw Inter font for headings. Use Playfair Display or Cormorant Garamond for elegant serif headlines.
Make sure forms use proper input controls with clear focus states and submit feedback using sonner toasts.
Implement the interactive Before/After drag slider with high precision.
Include the 3 confirmed Invisalign packages: Express (£2,400), Lite (£3,000), Comprehensive (£3,990) with finance calculation breakdown (£50.40/mo).
Ensure the mobile sticky CTA bar is responsive and hidden on desktop screens (md:hidden).

UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.data_testid_rule: MUST include data-testid attribute on all interactive/key elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, pricing cards).
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.contrast_rule: Ensure readable contrast for all text. Hover states MUST set explicit text color alongside background changes.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.no_universal_transition: Do not apply transition: all globally. Transition specific properties like opacity, color, background-color, border-color.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT.mobile_padding: Maintain generous internal padding (p-6 or p-8) inside containers with borders to avoid edge collisions.
